## Our Team

We are a group of students in the DSML course working together on our final project.
This website introduces our team and each member.

## Introductions by Seymen Kizilkaya

### Jimmy Yu

Jimmy is from China and lives in the United States. He enjoys trying new foods and has traveled to many countries. In his spare time, he likes programming games. His teammates describe him as kind and helpful.

### Seymen Kizilkaya

Hi, I’m Seymen Kizilkaya. I’m Turkish, I live in Germany, and I study economics in Switzerland. I enjoy cooking and playing the piano. I also love playing and watching football.

### Subham Pradhan

Subham is from India and studies international affairs. He enjoys judo, likes working out, and loves watching anime. His teammates think he’s pretty cool.
